title: Fatal History
description: A lightweight mod that logs your deaths with coordinates, dimension info, and inventory snapshots. Never lose your items again!
body:
# Fatal History 
**is a lightweight utility mod for Fabric designed to help you keep track of your deaths. No more frantic screenshots or lost items — every detail is recorded and stored in an easy-to-read log.**

### ✨ Features:
**Detailed Logging:** Records date, time, coordinates, and the dimension of your death.

**Inventory Snapshot:** Shows exactly what you were carrying before the "You Died" screen appeared.

**Visual Markers**: Optional world beacons to guide you back to your items.

**HUD Overlay:** View recent death info directly on your screen without opening menus.

**Highly Customizable:** Toggle markers, HUD, and set auto-deletion for old logs.

**Search & Cleanup:** Easily find specific entries or clear the history.

**Localization:** Available in English and Russian langauge
